create_table:
CREATE TABLE assignment_submissions (
  file_url text,
  grade numeric,
  feedback text,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  assignment_id uuid,
  student_id uuid,
  submitted_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE assignments (
  faculty_id uuid,
  course_id uuid,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  description text,
  title text,
  total_marks numeric DEFAULT 100,
  created_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
  due_date timestamp without time zone
);

CREATE TABLE attendance_ping_logs (
  bssid text,
  student_id uuid,
  session_id uuid,
  id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('attendance_ping_logs_id_seq'::regclass),
  ping_time timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
  signal_strength integer,
  device_hash text
);

CREATE TABLE attendance_records (
  status attendance_status,
  student_id uuid,
  session_id uuid,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  penalty_reason text,
  override_by text,
  penalty boolean DEFAULT false,
  admin_override boolean DEFAULT false,
  points numeric,
  avg_signal_strength numeric,
  duration_minutes numeric DEFAULT 0,
  last_seen_at timestamp without time zone,
  first_seen_at timestamp without time zone,
  calculated_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
  ping_count integer DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE courses (
  name text NOT NULL,
  code text,
  description text,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  created_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE faculty (
  photo_url text,
  designation text,
  honorarium_rate_per_hour numeric,
  created_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
  years_experience integer,
  department text,
  id uuid NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE feedback_questions (
  active boolean DEFAULT true,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  created_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
  category text,
  question text NOT NULL,
  type feedback_question_type
);

CREATE TABLE feedback_responses (
  yes_no boolean,
  rating integer,
  question_id uuid,
  student_id uuid,
  session_id uuid,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  text_answer text,
  submitted_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE google_tokens (
  created_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
  refresh_token text NOT NULL,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
  access_token text,
  expiry_time bigint,
  role text DEFAULT 'student'::text
);

CREATE TABLE notifications (
  type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general'::text,
  title text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
  sent_by uuid,
  is_read boolean DEFAULT false,
  session_id uuid,
  course_id uuid,
  recipient_id uuid,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  message text NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE session_materials (
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  faculty_id uuid,
  title text,
  session_id uuid,
  uploaded_by uuid,
  created_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
  course_id uuid,
  file_type text DEFAULT 'pdf'::text,
  content text,
  file_url text
);

CREATE TABLE sessions (
  session_type_id uuid,
  created_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
  created_by uuid,
  status session_status DEFAULT 'scheduled'::session_status,
  end_time time without time zone NOT NULL,
  start_time time without time zone NOT NULL,
  title text NOT NULL,
  session_date date NOT NULL,
  venue_id uuid,
  faculty_id uuid,
  course_id uuid,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  category_id uuid,
  feedback_deadline timestamp with time zone
);

CREATE TABLE skills (
  name text NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
  details text,
  category_id uuid
);

CREATE TABLE student_course_attendance (
  updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
  course_id uuid NOT NULL,
  attendance_percentage numeric NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  student_id uuid NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE students (
  id uuid NOT NULL,
  mac_verified boolean DEFAULT false,
  created_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
  enrollment_no text,
  program_name text,
  device_hash text,
  mac_address text,
  photo_url text
);

CREATE TABLE system_settings (
  scanner_interval_minutes integer DEFAULT 6,
  id integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  ping_interval integer DEFAULT 10,
  pings_per_session integer DEFAULT 6,
  presence_threshold integer DEFAULT 3,
  attendance_window integer DEFAULT 60,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
  min_signal integer DEFAULT 2
);

CREATE TABLE users (
  email text NOT NULL,
  is_active boolean DEFAULT true,
  first_name text,
  last_name text,
  role user_role NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  preferences jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
  created_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
  password_hash text NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE venues (
  building text,
  created_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
  is_active boolean DEFAULT true,
  router_bssid text,
  name text NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4()
);
